name: Decrypto
summary: Two teams race to decipher their own coded clues while intercepting the opponents' code.
rules_text: Two teams each secretly hold four keywords numbered 1-4. Each round each team appoints an Encryptor who draws a secret 3-digit code card using digits 1-4. The Encryptor writes three public clues, one per digit, that point to the matching keyword by meaning only, never by spelling, position, or private info, and never reusing a past clue. White's clues are read first. Both teams write a guessed 3-digit code, but intercept is skipped in round one. Black announces its intercept guess, then White announces its own decode attempt. Point of correctness is checked against the true code. Correct intercept gives the intercepting team one Interception token; failed decode gives the decoding team one Miscommunication token. Then Black's clues are handled symmetrically. Tokens are tracked openly. First team to 2 Interceptions wins; first team to 2 Miscommunications loses. Encryptors rotate each round.
rating_reason: Team code deduction with hidden keywords and talk, fits
